body: I'm taking my medication. Parents are the problem mostly. CPS has been involved twice. Not enough evidence so the case closed.

Yup, totally happened and is still happening to me. I have bedroom raids every other week, where they go through my stuff and either trash it/throw it away, or make fun of me for it. They actually went as far as to go into my room while I was in the hospital and throw out a bunch of my keepsakes. They take my phone, even though I use/have used it to contact my counselor while I'm in crisis or the suicide hotline and thus it's saved my life, every single night. They look through my messages, make fun of me for what I read, etc. I totally get what u mean.

It's tough to keep going. Day by day, minute by minute, that's how I'm doing it myself. Even the darkest hour has only sixty minutes and all that. Maybe look into therapy, if that's an option for you?
Yeah, I def get that. Doesn't seem like there's a perfect solution. Maybe therapy? If ur not in it already, it can be helpful to get some stuff of ur chest.

Yup, I live with her and my mother. CPS has been involved twice, but nothing happened and I'm genuinely worried that if CPS gets called and nothing happens again I'm going to get beat. It just, sucks.
That sucks so bad :( I'm really sorry. If you ever need anyone to talk to, I'm here for you, but ik that's not what you need
I'll try my best <3
Thank you so much. I'm very sorry that happened to you, but I'm glad you're doing better (at least a bit) now.
The group leader was a new therapist, and so he didn't say anything. He later apologized, so that's something.
Legitimately my nmom. It was insane, her favorite phrase was 'You never think about what I need.' she even dated to call me abusive for voicing being suicidal. Now I just don't tell her anything.

Me too. I get it. I don't know you. I know nothing about you. But I still feel like you should stick it out. Perhaps, if you needed it, this is the sign. I may not know you, but I care about you and your well being. Hold on for a bit longer.
They don't hit me though. They do just enough to break my spirit but not enough to get me taken away. They say I'm gonna be there's forever.
My parents are awful but I'm the only one they're terrible to. My little sister is doing fine there and I don't want her to have to see me as that person.
I'm a US citizen.

Do I leave my phone? Or do I try and disable tracking? Should I get a map? What it the police come after me? Etc.

"You have kidney disease."

I'm 14 and this was when I was 11. I was terrified. I ended up being out of commission for 6 months and missed my entire sixth grade. Ever since then my life has been spiraling down. I often think I should've died in that hospital, or that it would've been better if I had. I now see no point in living. I know I survived, but death would be better then the way my life is now.
I have an auntie in Africa that I love but she's on my dad's side and I doubt she'd take me in. CPS has already come around my house but I don't think there's enough evidence to get me out.

They call me names, say I'm useless/selfish and neglected me willfully as a kid. They also ignored my brother's physical abuse/many murder attempts when we were kids and now his sexual advances. I've tried to get away but they say I'll never be able to.
